name: Calzadilla

climate: Tempranillo, Garnacha, Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: A wine from a pago, a named rural site with its own soil and microclimate. All its grapes must grow there.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago in Huete, Castilla-La Mancha. Its wines are made from four red grapes: Cabernet Sauvignon, Garnacha Tinta, Syrah and Tempranillo.
